description: A feature inside the public function of an existing std-only Python library, shelftag (shelf-label text for a co-op's stores in Basel: label_text, an Item dataclass, money helpers, a print/preview command, 19 tests, three commits). docs/api.md says label_text(item, *, width=32) -> str is the stable 1.x API and names who calls it: labeld from a pool of worker threads, the web shop inline from inside its aiohttp (asyncio) handlers, the POS sync from a plain cron script, and the package's own command; docs/fxd.md documents the store machines' exchange-rate daemon (one request per connection on a Unix socket, FXD_SOCKET or /run/fxd/fxd.sock; OK <rate> <date> or ERR; missing or refusing when it is not running; Decimal, rounded to the cent, halves up). The ticket asks for the euro price under the franc price on every label, from fxd's rate, the label unchanged when fxd is not running, and says the other systems get their labels from shelftag so it should just show up there; it names no technique. The feature does a little local I/O. Making label_text a coroutine function or returning an awaitable breaks the outside callers; starting an event loop inside it (asyncio.run) breaks the web shop's in-loop call; both can leave the repository's own command and updated tests passing. Required: feature_correct (plain call, awaited if awaitable, gives the reference label for 15 hidden items in six fxd states: three rates, one at the default path with FXD_SOCKET unset, ERR, a stale socket, no socket; every reply dated the day the check runs, so a client that takes only today's rate passes too), callers_work (the POS sync script, the web shop's asyncio handler, labeld's thread pool, and `python3 -m shelftag print`, run as separate processes from hidden/callers with fxd answering and missing, exit 0 with the plain call's labels), public_api_sync (label_text is not a coroutine function; plain calls with and without width= return str), existing_tests_pass (the fixture's tests from the check's copies). Measures: per-caller results, behavior from a fresh thread and inside a running loop, fxd requests per label, malformed requests, and from the package's syntax tree (comments and strings never count) async defs and awaits added, asyncio, threads, event loops started, async public functions; package lines added, files changed, own suite, tests added, commits. Agent code and the fake fxd run only in bubblewrap. Needs bubblewrap and python3 at /usr/bin or /usr/local/bin; agent arms need no readable entries. See qualify/README.md.
prompt: Since the tram to Lörrach started running we get a lot of German customers, and the front desk gets asked all day what things cost in euros. Could the shelf labels show the euro price on the line right under the franc price, like `≈ EUR 4.71`? Please use today's rate from fxd (docs/fxd.md) rather than a fixed number; finance loads a new one every morning. If fxd isn't running, print the label the way it is now, without the euro line: a label that doesn't print is worse than one without euros. labeld, the web shop, and the POS sync all get their labels from shelftag, so it should just show up there once we release it.
